claims.claim_text: We intend to be the exclusive supplier of fully-electric and hybrid-electric propulsion systems for the Cessna Caravan to Textron Aviation Inc. (TAI) for an eight-year term. Cessna Caravan aircraft with the propulsion systems installed will be co-branded as 'Cessna Caravan SAM EP1'.

We will purchase 90 new Cessna Caravans over a five-year period from TAI, with deliveries beginning in 2024 and with an option for up to 38 additional Cessna Caravans to be delivered over seven years.
Our operator software suite is being developed in partnership with Palantir Technologies Inc. to enable the regional air-mobility market to operate at scale.
Through our subsidiary Southern Airways Express, and SkyWest Airlines, Inc. ('SkyWest') are partnered to provide a pilot hiring and training pathway.

Surf Air Mobility / Southern Airways is the largest commuter airline in the United States and the largest passenger operator of Cessna Grand Caravan EXs by scheduled departures, with multi-year contracts with the U.S. federal government to operate Essential Air Service routes. The combined network served approximately 176,131 passengers across 41 cities with approximately 31,476 departures in 2023.
We have entered into a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Signature Flight Support LLC for fixed base operator (FBO) services (e.g. fueling, hangaring, parking and aircraft rental) at airports.
Surf Air Mobility intends to develop proprietary EP1 powertrain technology (fully-electric and hybrid-electric powertrains for the Cessna Caravan) including proprietary software and power controls.
